text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen was able to achieve 
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see... My, that is a splendid idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A letter arrived from the Mejiro family. 
It seems they are hosting a victory 
celebration for me soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And it says that you should definitely 
join the party too, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"‘Please allow us to entertain the Trainer 
who guided McQueen to victory,’ it says. 
Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My, there is no need to be so on guard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A simple dress for the ladies and a suit 
for the gentlemen will do just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? In that case... ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, on our next day off, let us go 
shopping for clothes together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I certainly want to properly introduce my 
wonderful Trainer, after all."
